verdict.rationale: GitCafe documents a REST API with an OpenAPI 3.1 description, idempotent `requestId` retries and `409 Conflict` concurrency protection. None of the evidence mentions API versioning, version pinning, or a deprecation policy or timeline. These adjacent API-quality features do not count toward this story, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
